value: Every colour, size, radius and gap lives in one token file, in light and dark, and a test fails the build when a colour pair drops below WCAG AA. On our own Site it also caught a real bug: the logo disappeared on the dark header.

howItWorks.title: One token file drives the page, and CI checks every colour pair

workflow: Seed the colour roles from the brand colours (brand-palette-roles does this step).
Fill tokens.json with the skill's role names, then generate tokens.css.
Replace every literal colour, size and gap in the CSS with a token.
Run the contrast check and add a test so a stale tokens.css or a failing pair fails CI.

inAction.caption: Dark mode before and after. Before, the logo's slate tile matched the header and vanished; after, it keeps a hairline edge on a neutral dark canvas.
